name: Create GitHub Issue
description: Create an issue in a GitHub repository with title, body, labels, assignees, and milestone. Handles markdown formatting and label validation.

steps.name: Create the issue via GitHub API

code.source:
const resp = $.steps.createIssue.response || {};
return {
  issueNumber: resp.number,
  title: resp.title,
  state: resp.state,
  url: resp.html_url,
  labels: (resp.labels || []).map(l => l.name || l),
  assignees: (resp.assignees || []).map(a => a.login),
  createdAt: resp.created_at,
  created: !!resp.number,
  summary: resp.number
    ? 'Created issue #' + resp.number + ': ' + resp.title + ' in ' + $.input.owner + '/' + $.input.repo
    : 'Failed to create issue'
};
